correctness.rationale: The stable-set polytope is coordinatewise downward closed, so projection of all-ones dominates every cube point; its projection coordinates are all strictly below one for paths/cycles, giving unique farthest point. Cauchy–Schwarz and maximum independent set orbit mixing yield the general graph bound with exact equality condition. For paths, edge constraints form the integral stable-set hull (bipartite TU); displayed positive KKT multipliers and sum-of-squares identity give the unique minimizer in every order including n=2. Cycles use vertex transitivity and alpha=floor(n/2), giving exact squared gaps and the even-zero, odd-(n+1)/(2n) edge-closing jump. Reconstructed exact path KKT stationarity for n=6,7,8,9; all pass. Finite checks support but are not the universal proof.
